name: Default Agent Failure Rules
description: Common agent-trace anomalies over DProvenanceKit's vendor-neutral event vocabulary. These are the names produced by `dprovenancekit ingest` (OTel/OTLP traces normalized to tool_call.*, llm_call.*, agent_invocation.*). Native integration traces (openai-agents `function.*`, LangChain `toolStarted`/`toolEnded`) emit different names — ingest them, or write a preset targeting those types. Rules whose signal needs data no emitter yet produces (a registered-tool list, a distinct tool-result-vs-reasoning event) are intentionally omitted until the emitters carry it.

rules.message: Runaway tool use: the agent made more than 10 tool calls in a single run.
A tool call completed but was not followed by a model step that could use its result.
